The '''Jedi Archives''' of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] was a smaller collection of materials than its larger counterpart in the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Located in the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Ossus Academy]], the Archives, like its equivalent, were open at all hours and were accessible to all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in need of information.

==History==
[[File:TionneRoom-Leviathan2.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The beginning of the archives collection being collected at Yavin IV.]]
After the [[Invasion of Yavin 4|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[New Jedi Order]] relocated to Ossus where [[Jedi historian]], [[Tionne Solusar]] compiled a great wealth of manuscripts and [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Old Jedi Order's]] scattered treasures.

In the later years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], after the retaking of Coruscant by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Master Tionne added data to the stacks regarding the history of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Recovering the founding scripts of the Order from within the [[Sacred spire/Legends|Sacred spire]] and great amounts of information from the [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] treasure rooms, Tionne quickly built up a great collection. Tionne would also come into possession of the [[Great Holocron/Legends|Great Holocron]], a great discovery for the Jedi Order. She moved the information from Coruscant to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to Ossus in order to keep a solid grasp on all treasures and so that she could update and research thoroughly.

[[File:Tionne_jedi_archives.jpg|thumb|right|300px|[[Tionne Solusar]] working in the Archives on Coruscant.]]
When the Coruscant Temple was rebuilt, Tionne moved a large portion of the information back to the stacks on the Galactic capital. Due to her involvement at the Ossus academy though, Tionne formally established a branch of the Archives at the academy. Used to educate [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Younglings]] and to help in research, the archives contained a thorough collection of galactic history and politics; though it was not used to store detailed information of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] or their technology.

During the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] [[Battle of Ossus (Second Galactic Civil War)|invasion]], [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]] infiltrated the Archives and was disappointed to find it lacking information on her new [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|acquisition]].

When the academy was abandoned for the safety of the Jedi's secret [[Jedi Outpost|Endor base]], the archives were stripped of information and taken offworld. While the academy was closed and abandoned, The recovering Master Solusar continued her work out of the larger Archives on Coruscant.
